tool.name: automation-get
tool.description: Returns the summary plus config, state, and updatedAt. Returns source only when includeSource is true.

usage_rules.rule: Set includeSource only when you are about to edit or fix the script.
To fix a failing automation, read lastError together with the source, then preview a corrected version under the same name.

example.context: User says: "the weather automation broke, fix it"
